privacy.metaDescription: What data Wild Grove, a portfolio project, keeps, what it uses it for, and who else processes it.

owner.title: Who Is Behind This
owner.body: Wild Grove is a fictional restaurant, built as a portfolio project by Stephano Camarena Villa. There is no business behind it. The person responsible for the data this site keeps is its author, and you can reach them at <email>contact@wildgrove.cv</email>.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.body: Depending on what you use on the site:

items.account: Your account: name, email and password, or your basic Google profile if you sign in with Google.
items.reservations: Reservations: date, time, party size and phone number.
items.orders: Orders: the dishes, the delivery address if you choose delivery and, if you request a receipt, your DNI for a boleta or your RUC, company name and tax address for a factura.
items.reviews: Reviews: the text, the rating and any photos you upload.
items.chat: Chat: the messages you write to Sage or to the team.
items.technical: Technical data: your IP address, used to limit how many requests someone can make and to stop abuse.

collect.outro: This is a demo, so you don't need to use real data. A made-up name and an email you can access are enough to try everything. Don't enter a real DNI or RUC.

use.title: How We Use Your Information
use.body: Only to make the site work:

items.account: Managing your account, reservations and orders
items.emails: Sending you confirmation and update emails
items.chat: Replying to you in the chat

use.outro: We do not sell, rent or share your information for marketing purposes. There is no advertising and no profiling of any kind.

processors.title: Who Else Processes Your Data
processors.body: To work, the site relies on these third-party services, and each one receives only what it needs:

items.insforge: InsForge: the database, accounts and photo storage.
items.ai: An AI provider (OpenAI or OpenRouter, with TypeSafe as a fallback): receives chat messages when Sage replies. Don't write anything in the chat you wouldn't want to share with them.
items.maps: Google Maps: receives what you type when searching for a delivery address.
items.google: Google: if you sign in with your Google account.
items.upstash: Upstash: keeps your IP address for a short time to count requests.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: Your data is kept for as long as your account exists or the demo keeps running. Since this is a portfolio, the database may be reset or wiped without notice. If you'd like your account and everything tied to it deleted sooner, write to <email>contact@wildgrove.cv</email>.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or object to its use, under Peru's Personal Data Protection Law No. 29733. Write to <email>contact@wildgrove.cv</email> and you'll get a reply as soon as possible.

cookies.title: Cookies and Storage
cookies.body: The site uses cookies only to keep you signed in and to remember your language. Your browser's storage also keeps preferences and unfinished things, such as a cart without an account, your currency, the theme or notices you already closed. There are no tracking, advertising or analytics cookies.

privacy.contactDescription: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, I'm happy to help.

terms.metaDescription: The terms of use for Wild Grove, a fictional restaurant built as a portfolio project.

about.title: What This Site Is
about.body: Wild Grove is a portfolio project, not a real restaurant. The menu, reservations, orders, payments and chat all work, but only as a demo. No reservation is honoured, no order is prepared or delivered, and no real money is charged.

use.title: Use of the Website
use.body: You're welcome to explore and try everything the site offers. In return, we ask that you don't try to break or overload it, don't upload content that is offensive, illegal or that you don't have rights to, and don't use other people's data.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You can create an account to try the site. Since this is a demo, accounts and their data may be reset or deleted at any time. An account that abuses the site may be suspended.

orders.title: Reservations, Orders and Wallet
orders.body: Reservations and orders are for demonstration only and create no obligation. The wallet uses test balance: each new account receives an amount when it signs up, and the administrator can add more. It cannot be bought or redeemed and has no value. Receipts and invoices issued by the site have no tax validity.

reviews.title: Reviews and Content You Upload
reviews.body: Reviews are moderated before they are published. What you write and the photos you upload remain yours, but you give us permission to show them on the site. We may remove any review, and you can ask for yours to be deleted.

ip.title: Code and Intellectual Property
ip.body: This site's code is open source and published under the MIT license on <repo>GitHub</repo>. The Wild Grove name and brand are fictional. All images on the site are AI-generated: they are not real photos and are not taken from any other platform.

liability.title: Disclaimer and Limitation of Liability
liability.body: This site is provided "as is", with no guarantee that it will be available, free of errors or accurate. Since it is a demo, its author is not liable for any damage that may arise from using it.

changes.title: Changes to These Terms
changes.body: These terms may change from time to time. If you keep using the site after a change, you accept the new terms.

terms.contactDescription: Happy to clarify anything. Write in and you'll get a reply as soon as possible.
